items.title: Keep receipt-only validation independent of the browser runtime
items.why: The reconciled complete-suite run hit the15second child timeout while receipt-only mode statically imported Playwright. The same test passed earlier; metadata validation does not need the browser runtime.
items.recipe: Load Playwright inside actual capture mode. Extend the existing real CLI negative fixture with a deterministic ESM resolution tripwire that forbids the browser dependency during receipt-only validation. Retain observed-theme validation, file-copy refusal and timeout bounds.
items.acceptance: The existing real CLI refuses missing/mismatched theme evidence before copying, and reaches the expected theme errors even with Playwright resolution forbidden. Actual capture mode still produces reviewed source-bound images; full source and deployment acceptance remain mandatory.
items.userOutcome: Operators receive reliable fail-closed receipt validation without requiring a browser dependency to load.
items.stageRationale: Repair an actually observed release prerequisite; no product UI, identity or pricing change.
